scope: Independently authored unit sphere, P2 geometry, HDiv order 2, linear susceptibility 0.4; bounded dense Gram
optimization: Geometry-specific fused Duffy moment kernels; original quadrature and per-component summation order retained
limits: Research artifacts, not a common installed release wheel. CPU reference build-source adoption remains provisional.
API total includes FE setup, assembly, transfers, solve, result recovery and object destruction; Engine initialization and HDF5 controller transport measured separately.
First benchmark follows parity warmups; no full-process cold-start claim.
Exact owned buffers exclude CUDA/library/global peaks; 50 ms process samples include baseline and retained CPU certification operator and can miss spikes.
CPU sampler runs in the solver process; GPU process sampler runs in the controller, so instrumentation cost is asymmetric.
No nonlinear BH, general FE, IH, large adaptive compression or release qualification claim.
